title: Aliana Sheriff
text:
Welcome! My name is Aliana Sheriff and I am a current Junior at Melissa High in the International Baccalaureate Diploma Program. With an education grounded in global mindedness and international awareness, I’m ready to investigate my interests in data, public policy, and international relations.
